description: Located features the case views name on the land. Each records where its position comes from. They are not evidence: no statement, measurement or hypothesis rests on them.

features.name: Catchment outlet
features.method: Outlet of the frozen catchment revision 1 (outlet_snapped in data/case/geometry/ait-bouguemez-catchment.geojson): one OpenStreetMap coordinate, the vertex 31.637197 N, 6.536500 W of river way 326552769 (Assif n Bou Guemez; source register SCI-36), snapped 94 m to the cell of maximum flow accumulation on the conditioned DEM (research/geospatial/study-area.md, outlet)
features.datasetId: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (2021 release); OpenStreetMap river way 326552769 (SCI-36), one coordinate as the outlet input
features.attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved; Catchment derived by Siterra from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (2021 release); outlet input © OpenStreetMap contributors (hydrography context)
features.license: Copernicus DEM licence (data-sources-and-methods.md, terrain); outlet input ODbL-1.0 (OpenStreetMap)
limitations: The point all of the catchment drains to on the 1 arc-second DEM grid; not a gauge and not a surveyed point.
Its input is one community-mapped OpenStreetMap coordinate, not survey or official data.

features.name: Tabant
features.method: Position of the Tabant acceptance point of the catchment freeze (data-sources-and-methods.md, study area), checked on 2026-10-29 against the 10 m true colour image: it lies on the village. The GeoNames populated place Tabant (geonameid 2532270, feature code PPLA3; gazetteer extract for Morocco, snapshot retrieved 2026-10-27, source register SCI-154) lies about 1.1 km south-east of it on bare hillside and is not used for the position; the name and the identifier are GeoNames'
features.datasetId: GeoNames gazetteer extract for Morocco (SCI-154, MA.zip, snapshot 2026-10-27, SHA-256 c25481b5aaa5855eaf5c5363abc09cb32c7c40b36799bcc4852bc5f00eafe875)
limitations: A label position for orientation only; not a boundary and not a surveyed point. The GeoNames gazetteer position of Tabant (31.65255 N, 6.41049 W) is about 1.1 km south-east of this point, on bare hillside, as seen on the 10 m true colour image.

features.name: Aït Ouchi
features.method: Village coordinates published in SCI-04, used as an acceptance point of the catchment freeze (data-sources-and-methods.md, study area)
features.attribution: Aakairi, M. et al. (2026), People and Nature, CC BY 4.0
limitations: A published locator for the village; not a surveyed point and not the extent of the village or its pastures.
